about_the_game:
Gameplay introduction

By turning over and matching cards with the same pattern, eliminate all pairs of cards and unlock hidden exquisite illustrations~

  • Flip a card: Click on any card to turn it over, and you can turn over two cards at a time.

  • Match: If the two cards have the same pattern, they will be eliminated successfully; otherwise, they will be automatically covered.

  • Victory condition: Eliminate all cards on the board to pass the level!

Background introduction

"When the golden wind and jade dew meet, it is better than countless people in the world."

You will become a romantic talent. In the moonlit night with swaying lanterns and the painting pavilion filled with ink fragrance, you will gradually unlock the fateful encounter with many peerless beauties through clever flipping of cards.

She is a dancer from the Western Regions in colorful feathered clothes, with her toes lightly touching the starry sand of Dunhuang;

Or she is a girl from the south of the Yangtze River holding an umbrella, with the bright moon over the Twenty-Four Bridges reflected in her eyes;

"This feeling can be recalled, but it was already gone at that time..."

——Can this gilded dream live up to the longing?
